name: PD 110 was established by Ordinance No. 16205, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 2, 1979. Ordinance No. 16205 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 16205 was amended by Ordinance No. 24755, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 24, 2001. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16205; 24755; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 110 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 110 was established by Ordinance No. 16205, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 2, 1979. Ordinance No. 16205 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Subsequently, Ordinance No. 16205 was amended by Ordinance No. 24755, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 24, 2001. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16205; 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 110 is established on property generally located on the west line of Shiloh Road, between Centerville Road and Ruidosa Avenue. The size of PD 110 is approximately 31.338 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16205; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-110.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Conceptual, Landscape, And Development Plans
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-110.104.CONCEPTUAL, LANDSCAPE, AND DEVELOPMENT PLANS.
(a)Development and use of the property must comply with the overall conceptual plan (Exhibit 110A), Phase IV development plan (Exhibit 110B), and Phase IV landscape plan (Exhibit 110C). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the overall conceptual plan, Phase IV development plan, or Phase IV landscape plan, the provisions of this article control.
(b)The fire station building in the area designated as Phase IV shall be in accordance with the Phase IV development plan. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Main Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-110.105.MAIN USES.
(a)Phase I. A 14.91 acre tract for an existing home for the aged, housing for the elderly and community and recreation uses and future expansion of the home for the aged.
(b)Phase II. A 5.75 acre tract for housing for the elderly and/or community or recreation uses.
(c)Phase III. A 10.678 acre tract with uses to be confined to housing for the aged, and/or community or recreation uses, and a fire station. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Building Area
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.106.BUILDING AREA. The gross building area for all allowable structures may not exceed 400,000 square feet for Phase I and 250,000 square feet for Phase III. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Maximum Heights
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-110.107.MAXIMUM HEIGHTS.
(a)Limitations of 36 feet in height plus allowable 12-foot extensions on top of the buildings in Phases I and II to permit an elevator penthouse or bulkhead, mechanical equipment room, cooling tower, tank, ornamental cupola, or dome. Phase III may extend to 48 feet in height with the same provisions as referenced above.
(b)In Phases I and III within the area designated with a two-story height limitation, buildings are limited to 24 feet in height with an allowable 12-foot extension on top of the buildings for those items listed above. The fire station must be a one-story building located within this designated area and may not exceed 31 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.108.DENSITY. Density for housing for the elderly may be no greater than 30 dwelling units per acre for each phase. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.109.PARKING. Parking must be provided as required for each use in the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance and located as shown on each approved site plan. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.110.SCREENING. A solid screening fence will be provided in accordance with requirements of Division 20-800 of the Comprehensive Zoning Ordinance. A six-foot-high masonry screening wall will be provided. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.111.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the requirements of Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-110.112.PAVING.
(a)All required paving must be in accordance with the requirements established in Section 20-812 of Chapter 51.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.113.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Utilization of this property must be in compliance with all other applicable codes and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.114.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-110.115.ZONING MAP. PD 107 is located on Zoning Map Nos. G-10 and G-11. (Ord. Nos. 24755; 25508)
